name: Agüero (Spain)
description: Yellow field with a red triangle with its base along the hoist and its apex at the fly, charged with a white knight on horseback.
history: Municipal flag of Agüero; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: triangle with its base along the hoist and its apex at the fly
knight on horseback with lance and shield
